---
name: Security issue
about: Report security issues privately to axelar-security@commonprefix.com
---

If you have found a security issue, please report it privately to axelar-security@commonprefix.com. Do not publish security-sensitive information in this issue tracker.

For more details, see the [Axelar Bug Bounty](https://docs.axelar.dev/resources/bug-bounty/).
